title: Gonzalo Plata leaves Flamengo and completes sale to Dynamo Moscow
seoTitle: Gonzalo Plata leaves Flamengo for Dynamo Moscow
subtitle: Striker says goodbye to teammates at the Ninho do Urubu and misses the team in the derby
excerpt: Gonzalo Plata bids farewell to his teammates and is sold by Flamengo to Dynamo Moscow after a multi‑million‑dollar deal.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Striker Gonzalo Plata said goodbye to Flamengo's squad on Friday morning and has a flight booked to Russia. The transfer comes amid negotiations with Dynamo Moscow and confirms his absence from Sunday’s derby.

Farewell at the Ninho do Urubu

Plata was at the Ninho do Urubu on Friday for his last training session with the red‑black club. He is expected to travel on Saturday for his presentation at Dynamo Moscow. He will be accompanied by Matheus Martins from Botafogo, who was also sold to the same Russian side. Both players miss the derby at the Maracanã.

Negotiation value and terms

The deal is reported at €10 million, roughly R$ 60.1 million, plus an additional €2 million in bonuses. Flamengo had signed the forward in the second half of 2024 from Al‑Sadd of Qatar.

Wear and tear leading to the exit

The club’s hierarchy and coach Leonardo Jardim dealt with a series of issues concerning the 25‑year‑old’s behavior. Incidents included lack of effort in training, tardiness and fines imposed in March. The player and his staff pressed for a salary raise or a move to Europe after the World Cup, prompting the board to accept the transfer with the coach’s blessing.

Career and achievements with the red‑black

During his spell at the Rio club, the attacker played 100 matches and scored nine goals. Plata won six titles with Flamengo, including the 2024 Brazil Cup, the 2025 Libertadores, the 2025 Brazilian League, the 2025 Supercopa, and the Rio State Championships of 2025 and 2026.

Information from GE, R7 Sports.
